subject: The View Restaurant
cuisine: Scottish & Seafood Fine Dining · Cuillin Hills Hotel

media.alt_text: Dining room at The View Restaurant, Cuillin Hills Hotel, overlooking the Cuillin mountains in Portree

caption.body:
The View Restaurant at Cuillin Hills Hotel in Portree — Scottish seafood with views of the Cuillin mountains, and almost everything on the menu can be made GF.

The staff were lovely about it, and the food was some of the best I had on Skye. 5/5 on my GF safety scale. Book ahead if you're visiting in summer.
